intents.description: Customer is asking about the location, tracking, or delay of their package, or reporting a package marked as delivered but not received.
Customer is inquiring about the process of returning an item, tracking a refund, or cancelling an order.
exclusion_criteria: Returning an item explicitly because it is damaged (use DamagedOrDefective)
Returning because it's the wrong item (use WrongItem)

intents.description: Customer received a product that is physically damaged, defective, soiled, or missing parts.
inclusion_criteria: Not working out of the box
exclusion_criteria: Item works but is not what was ordered (use WrongItem)

intents.description: Customer received an incorrect product, wrong size, wrong color, or wrong version of an item.
inclusion_criteria: I ordered an iPhone X and got an 8
exclusion_criteria: Item is what they ordered but it is broken (use DamagedOrDefective)

intents.description: Customer is providing feedback or complaints about the delivery driver's behavior or where the package was left.
exclusion_criteria: Package is lost in transit without delivery scan (use DeliveryStatus)

intents.description: Issues related to Amazon Prime subscription fees, account security, unauthorized purchases, or payment failures.
exclusion_criteria: Refund for a physical item (use RefundsAndReturns)

intents.description: Technical support for Amazon digital products like Prime Video, Kindle, Amazon Music, or Fire TV.
exclusion_criteria: Questions about billing for these services (use AccountAndPayment)

intents.description: Customer is angry about a previous interaction with Amazon support, waiting for a promised callback, or demanding a manager.
inclusion_criteria: No one replied to my email
exclusion_criteria: General frustration about an order delay (use DeliveryStatus)

intents.description: Messages that do not fit into actionable support categories, including praise, spam, conversational fragments, or overly vague complaints. Non-English messages should ONLY be placed here if their underlying intent cannot be determined.
exclusion_criteria: Vague complaints that mention 'my order' (should be investigated)
Non-English messages that clearly express one of the other intents
